purpose: Define five Reality-era environment setting-board briefs from Current Story/World, era-life and Reality-root sources without inventing exact years, addresses, incidents or household details.

boards.name: トモリ

realityRoot.value: 長野県諏訪・中信文化圏

environmentEvidenceTargets: paper records, handwritten notes and in-person coordination are normal
supply can be delayed or missing without reducing all life to starvation
repair, reuse, parts salvage and container/string reuse visibly shape ordinary space
shopping and movement have meaningful time cost and infrastructure can be incomplete
distribution, informal mutual aid and repair work leave practical traces in the environment
retained hardware/materials have repair or continued-use reasons
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: source-backed postwar Tokyo-area repair/reconstruction streetscape and interiors appropriate to the chosen still-open exact year
era-appropriate household/workshop materials, packaging, signage, lighting and transport without poverty cosplay
mobility plausibility from Suwa/Chushin cultural root to the still-broad postwar Tokyo incident area

boards.name: ミチル
environmentEvidenceTargets: printed information, public signage, maps and timetables are active navigation tools
expanding roads, rail, new towns and older paths coexist rather than one replacing all others
new products and processed foods expand while energy/price pressure can coexist with prosperity
factory, urban-planning, development and resident-complaint systems leave visible ordinary-life traces
pollution and energy use affect daily comfort without turning every frame into disaster imagery
maps, tickets, notebooks and route choices belong naturally in lived space
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: source-backed Keihin development-area streetscape/interiors appropriate to a still-open exact year within the established era band
period-correct rail, road, signage, household goods, processed-food packaging and energy/pollution evidence
plausible mobility from western Shizuoka root to the broad Keihin development incident area

boards.name: ナギ
environmentEvidenceTargets: feature phone/PHS/mobile mail/PC mail/BBS/personal-site culture exists without modern smartphone assumptions
printed maps and digital information coexist
cash and physical transactions remain normal while convenience/abundance is normalizing
not-always-connected life and reply delay are ordinary rather than failure states
handle names, forwarding/copying, shared family PCs and forming privacy norms affect room and device layouts
screen privacy and dedicated storage for phone/key/printed directions/cable are physically plausible
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: source-backed early-mobile-internet domestic/device environment appropriate to the still-open exact year
period-correct feature-phone/PHS/PC/network access, printed directions, charging and shared-space practices
plausible school/employment mobility from Sendai-area root to the broad metropolitan incident area

boards.name: ユイ
boards.incidentArea: 荒川区〜東京東側生活圏
environmentEvidenceTargets: 2026 Tokyo rail, smartphone navigation and local landmarks coexist as ordinary infrastructure
cash, IC and QR/app payment can coexist without making payment UI the scene identity
convenience stores, delivery, online shopping and local shopping coexist
cloud photos, group logs, recommendations, edited/fake images, deepfakes and generative AI are ordinary information pressures
modern urban comfort can coexist with old-neighborhood traces without making Yui retro
paper-memory and older personal objects can remain meaningful beside current digital systems
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: current 2026 Arakawa/east-Tokyo ordinary streetscape, rail, housing and shopping references without exposing private addresses
local-history traces that exist in ordinary life but do not turn Yui into a retro-character stereotype

boards.name: アサ
environmentEvidenceTargets: identity-aware networks and multiple embodiment channels have ordinary offline/failure cases
access and ownership rules matter more than decorative future currency
mobility infrastructure accommodates multiple body types and devices
maintenance, hardware generations and attachment to older body/device choices are normal practical issues
body/account/person history can differ and authentication/personhood rules appear in daily infrastructure
different bodies can have different environmental needs without hierarchy or humanization pressure
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: future-system precedent research for accessible multi-body mobility, maintenance and identity/authentication without copying a franchise-specific interface
credible material/repair/access infrastructure rather than neon/chrome shorthand
ordinary human household and nonhuman/human coexistence scenarios that do not treat humanization as the goal
